name: extra-caffeine
description: Control idle-sleep prevention in a separately installed Extra Caffeine Mac app.
long_description: Requires Extra Caffeine 1.2+ (a separate paid purchase), macOS 14+, and a local MCPB-compatible client. Open the selected app and enable AI assistants before controlling it. The adapter verifies the installed app's vendor signature and delegates stdio to that edition's MCP server. Closed-app/disabled-access state is reported as tool errors; discovery alone does not mean control is ready. Ask the user before starting or scheduling. The app must stay open and cannot wake a sleeping Mac. No automatic install, access enablement, or remote Mac control.

app_path.title: Installed Extra Caffeine app
app_path.description: Choose the separately installed Extra Caffeine.app or Extra Caffeine Direct.app (version 1.2+). Open that edition and enable AI assistants before connecting.
